run_joint_graph_passes: run fx transformations on the joint forwards+backwards graph with constant folding and pattern matching
remove_no_ops: remove no-op operations like add with zero, sub with zero, mul with one, div by one from an fx graph
remove_redundant_views: remove redundant aten.view operations by reusing existing aliased views in an fx graph
constant_fold_uniform_value: run constant folding and replace uniform-value tensors with aten.full constructor calls
build_uniform_value_constant_folder: build a UniformValueConstantFolder to fold constants and replace uniform tensors with full constructor nodes
